Organic loading rate in the reactors (R1 and R2) feedstocks 2.3 Isolation and quantification of DNA Samples from the original inoculum (IN), substrates CM and MAS, and from both reactors (R1 & R2) loaded with 20, 60 and 100 % MAS were collected and sent to DNASsense ApS (Ålborg east, Denmark). The samples were collected a few days prior to increasing the amount of MASsludge and stored at -21 °C. FastDNA spin kit for soil (MP Biomedicals, USA) was used for DNA isolation. In short, 500 μL of sample was added to a lysing matrix E tube including 480 μL sodium phosphate buffer and 120 μL MT buffer. Bead beating to crush cells was conducted at 6 m/s for 4 × 40 s. The following DNA purification was determined by Gel electrophoresis applying Tapestation 2200 and D1000/High sensitivity D1000 screentapes (Agilent, USA). The DNA concentration was determined using Qubit dsDNA HS/BR Assay kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific, USA). 2.4 Amplicon sequencing of 16s RNA genes Amplificon libraries for bacteria/archaea 16S RNA gene (i.e., regions 1-8 (bV18-A) and 4-9 (aV49-A)) were prepared based on a custom protocoll. Extracted DNA (up to 25 ng) was used as template for PCR amplification, and each PCR reaction (50 μL) contained 0.2 mM dNTP mix, 0.01 units of Platinum SuperFi DNA Polymerase (Thermo Fisher Scientific, USA), and 500 nM of each forward and reverse primer in the supplied SuperFI Buffer. The forward and reverse PCR primers used include custom 24 nt barcode sequences followed by the sequences targeting bV18-A: [8F] AGRGTTYGATYMTGGCTCAG and [1391R] GACGGGCGGTGWGTRCA (Bacteria) and aV49-A: [515FB] GTGYCAGCMGCCGCGGTAA and [SSU1000ArR] GGCCATGCAMYWCCTCTC (Archaea) The resulting amplicon libraries were purified using the standard protocol for CleanNGS SPRI beads (CleanNA, NL) with a bead to sample ratio of 3:

DNA was eluted in 25 μL of nuclease free water (Qiagen, Germany). Sequencing libraries were prepared from the purified amplicon libraries using the SQK-LSK114 kit (Oxford Nanopore Technologies, UK) according to manufacturer protocol with the following modifications: 500 ng total DNA was used as input, and CleanNGS SPRI beads for library clean-up steps. DNA concentration was measured using Qubit dsDNA HS Assay kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific, USA). Gel electrophoresis using Tapestation 2200 and D1000/High sensitivity D1000 screentapes (Agilent, USA) was used to validate product size and purity of a subset of amplicon libraries. Resulting sequencing library was loaded onto a PromethION R10.4.1 flowcell and sequenced using the MinKNOW 24.06.15 software (Oxford Nanopore Technologies, UK). Reads were basecalled and de-multiplexed with MinKNOW guppy Dorado 7.4.14 using the super accurate basecalling algorithm (config r10.4.1_400bps_sup.cfg) and custom barcodes. 2.5 Downstream processing of sequenced reads The sequenced reads in the demultiplexed and basecalled fastq files were filtered for length (320 - 2000 bp) and quality (phred score >

steps.title: Collect and store feedstock samples
steps.instruction: Collect fish sludge in 60 L batches, freeze them, then thaw before use; collect cow manure and store at 4 °C; collect the initial inoculum from a mesophilic lab‑scale CSTR reactor and keep samples at –21 °C until DNA extraction.

steps.title: Isolate DNA from samples
steps.instruction: Extract DNA using the FastDNA spin kit for soil (MP Biomedicals, USA) following the kit protocol with the specified volumes and bead‑beating conditions.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL of each sample to a lysing matrix E tube containing 480 µL sodium phosphate buffer and 120 µL MT buffer.
Bead‑beat the tubes at 6 m s⁻¹ for 4 × 40 s.
Purify DNA as described by the kit; assess DNA size by Tapestation 2200 with D1000/High Sensitivity D1000 screentapes (Agilent, USA).
Quantify DNA concentration with the Qubit dsDNA HS/BR Assay kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific, USA).

steps.title: Perform PCR amplification of 16S regions
steps.instruction: Amplify bacterial and archaeal 16S rRNA gene regions using a custom two‑primer set in 50 µL reactions.

substeps.instruction: Use up to 25 ng of extracted DNA as template per reaction.
Prepare each 50 µL PCR mix with 0.2 mM dNTP mix, 0.01 U Platinum SuperFi DNA Polymerase (Thermo Fisher Scientific, USA), 500 nM of each forward and reverse primer, and the supplied SuperFI Buffer.
Archaeal primers: forward 515FB (GTGYCAGCMGCCGCGGTAA) and reverse SSU1000ArR (GGCCATGCAMYWCCTCTC).
Each primer includes a custom 24‑nt barcode sequence at its 5′ end.

steps.title: Purify amplicon libraries with SPRI beads
steps.instruction: Clean the PCR amplicons using CleanNGS SPRI beads (CleanNA, NL) according to the standard protocol with a bead‑to‑sample ratio of 3 : 1.

steps.title: Prepare Nanopore sequencing library
steps.instruction: Construct sequencing libraries from the purified amplicons using the SQK‑LSK114 kit (Oxford Nanopore Technologies, UK) with the modifications described.

substeps.instruction: Elute purified amplicons in 25 µL nuclease‑free water (Qiagen, Germany).
Use 500 ng total DNA as input for the library preparation.
Perform bead‑based clean‑up steps with CleanNGS SPRI beads as per the kit.
Measure final library concentration with the Qubit dsDNA HS Assay kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific, USA).
Validate library size and purity on a Tapestation 2200 with D1000/High Sensitivity D1000 screentapes (Agilent, USA) for a subset of libraries.

steps.title: Load library and run PromethION sequencing
steps.instruction: Load the prepared library onto a PromethION R10.4.1 flowcell and run sequencing using MinKNOW version 24.06.15.

steps.title: Basecall and demultiplex sequencing reads
steps.instruction: Basecall and demultiplex the raw data with MinKNOW Guppy/Dorado version 7.4.14 using the super‑accurate model (config r10.4.1_400bps_sup.cfg) and the custom barcodes.

steps.title: Filter reads by length and quality
steps.instruction: Filter the demultiplexed FASTQ files with filtlong (v.0.2) to retain reads 320–2000 bp in length and meeting the minimum mean quality score (‑min_mean_q) as specified.

steps.title: Download Greengenes reference database
steps.instruction: Obtain the Greengenes 2022.10 database in RESCRIPt format from the QIIME resource.

steps.title: Map reads to reference database
steps.instruction: Align the filtered reads to the Greengenes 2022.10 database using minimap2 (v2.24‑r1122) with the –ax map‑ont preset, then process the alignments with samtools (v1).

steps.title: Filter mapping results for alignment quality
steps.instruction: Remove mapping entries where the query‑sequence length deviates from the alignment length beyond the allowed threshold (as described in the protocol).
